_note: ceilings = the size on the day + 2%; a build over its ceiling fails, a build more than 5% under it asks for the ceiling to come down (tests/js/bundle_budget). app-chunks and chrome-chunks are the SUM of every chunk that entry imports statically — what a cold open waits on besides the entry itself; a dynamic import() is deliberately not counted, that being the point of making a module lazy. They are sums since 2026-09-18: reading only the first import let 15,287 B of chrome's cold open go uncounted the moment esbuild split the shared code in two, and a budget that can be met by moving bytes sideways is not a budget.
